corrections.cypher:
// VG:SV:KAU:CHANDA:P01:D08:V04  (WS CHANDA.P1.D8 RN76)
MATCH (p:Passage {canonical_key: $canonical_key})-[:HAS_TEXT_VERSION]->(t:TextVersion)
WHERE t.content_sha256 = $old_sha256
  AND t.text_nfc STARTS WITH $apparatus
SET t.text_nfc       = $new_text,
    t.content_sha256 = $new_sha256
RETURN p.canonical_key AS key, t.text_nfc AS text, t.content_sha256 AS sha;
